propositions: When a reconcile pass adopts a Jira key and writes the rebar-id label in-pass BEFORE the local CREATE event and binding are durably published, a rejected final push on an ephemeral runner loses all local state while the Jira label persists

The L10 binding_walk guard unconditionally stands down when a rebar-id label is present, preventing all existing automated healing paths (binding_walk dedup, differ suppression, BindingRecovery.recover_pending_bindings) from recovering the lost adopt

The symmetric completion of idempotent-replay design is a recovery extension that detects marked-but-unstored keys (deterministic inbound id label present, no binding-store entry, no local ticket) and replays the adopt through the existing inbound-create leaf instead of standing down

The recovery extension in _adopt_stands_down() preserves all existing L10/L11 protections: foreign/ghost markers, multi-marker keys, keys with live binding-store entries, and keys with live local tickets all keep standing down unconditionally

RED regression test simulation of lost-final-push runner failure demonstrates the walk stands down (adopted == []) on pre-fix code and replays the adopt deterministically on post-fix code, re-materializing the same local id and binding
bridge_fsck unbound_jira audit remains untouched and continues alerting until the binding exists, providing no suppression even after recovery extension applies
